evidence_notes.execution_semantics: Document adjusted-close construction, decision cutoff, timezone, corporate-action handling, and exact per-symbol official-session endpoints. Unadjusted open and nonfill semantics belong to a later portfolio module.
evidence_notes.tradability_fields: Show non-degenerate ST and suspension behavior under historically effective vendor definitions. Price-limit, missing-open, and nonfill evidence is required only for a later portfolio module and does not authorize that unimplemented module.
evidence_notes.exact_endpoint_resolution: Verify that signal-session t is present during candidate formation. For each signal-eligible record, missing t+20, t+1, or t+21 receives one of the three fixed unresolved reason codes; next quotes, reopening prices, last prices, and default recoveries are forbidden. Suspension-valuation and delisting-terminal-wealth adapters remain unimplemented.
evidence_notes.endpoint_reason_ledger_rights: Confirm that the complete per-security endpoint-reason ledger may be retained privately and hash-bound in the result receipt, and that aggregate reason-code counts may be published without redistributing licensed rows.
evidence_notes.data_rights: Cite the contract or license terms permitting local analysis, public aggregate outputs, metadata, hashes, and publication of the exact official-calendar session dates embedded in the receipt.
evidence_notes.official_calendar: Retain authoritative SSE/SZSE provenance, resolve any disagreement, verify all endpoint and quote-date membership rules, and bind the exact CSV bytes.

chronology_contract.timezone_rule: Every timestamp must be finite ISO-8601 with an explicit UTC offset.
chronology_contract.mutation_rule: Any input-byte or evidence change after reviewed_at invalidates this attestation and requires a new review and hash.

signature.trust_boundary: Identity and evidence authenticity require independent human verification.

completion_gate: All required booleans, including exact-endpoint and endpoint-ledger-rights assertions, must be true; all hashes must be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; all identities and timestamps must be complete; and status must become reviewed_pass before this artifact may enter the plan core.
